notes.title: Dev Log 2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey hey Goblins! 🍻[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/c1dafa5be388a2c73fe058e678d19c0474ac1114.png"][/img]
Goblin's have had their summer holidays to recharge. Nonetheless, it's still been a crazy few months here at the Hive.

Goblins joined the GamesCom 2025. We've had couple of our very first Devs Play -streams (more in the horizon).

And we've of course been busy crafting the new Early Access content :sunglasses:
We did a little pivot with a region formerly known as 'the Desert'. We've seen deserts in games plenty, so we turned it into a dangerous Highlands instead. Buzzing with creepy wild life and bandit outlaws. But that joint is still in the early makings.

The Dark Swamp and The Aqueducts are coming along nicely. We have some teasers here.

[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/7ffa4937ab3903b10a2c93159f40ae27682b1d99.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/1a6782cd41c4c1272ce828ae185fb4986e7b30f8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/4242acd852ea9132f0b58e11fae1d195f9427348.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/1be457aa9d440eb994f177a6c4ebc28df2303c5b.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]

We aim to host a closed playtest of the Dark Swamp area around next month or so, where people can explore the boggy swamplands inhabitet by the bug-eyed goblin neighbours: the Gulbers. Among other creepy critters and weirdos-alike.

Dark Swamp are will come with it's new gear, new materials, new enemies, new BOSSES and of course plenty of new places to explore.

[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/f509e1ac4305364055b597d6f1b60b872aca7147.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/23ba0269c292526f9e4a379f638ce7d30b04b2e2.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]

Can't wait to see how you like the new region 8) We are totally loving the aesthetics of the place!

Stay tuned for more info

We're always eager to hear your thoughts and suggestions. Have a great day, and remember, your feedback is invaluable! 

[b][i]~Potion 8[/i][/b]


[/p]

notes.title: Goblin’s Die is live at Gamescom!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Goblins! 🍻[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708102/f0a4c9b921d147853941b78981d0ae1522ca710e.jpg[/img]

We’re happy to share that Goblin’s Die will be playable at Gamescom this year. The demo has recently been updated with some notable additions.

The Jail area now features a new boss encounter with its own theme, adding a new challenge. Players will also have more choice in how they progress, including the ability to decide which boss to face, though the method for unlocking this is left for you to discover

We’ve also been working behind the scenes to make sure the world feels richer and smoother. We’ve introduced a range of updates, including fresh environmental visuals, enhanced audio elements, and optimizations designed to make gameplay run smoothly.

[b]Looking ahead toward Early Access[/b], our focus will be on expanding the game with additional areas, new enemy types, and more loot to discover. Gamescom will be a good opportunity to share a snapshot of where the game is now and to gather feedback for the next stages of development.

[b]If you’re coming to Gamescom[/b], make sure to drop by and try the latest build. 

We are at Booth B-032g - Hall 10.1 - Check the booth's exact location [url=https://exhibitors.gamescom.global/en/gamescom-exhibitors/hall-plan/?route=hallenplan2/index&&uuid=ef89c1ca4fba20176b4893249fa881f1&halle=10.2&standnr=D043g#plan]Here[/url]

Your feedback will help us shape the road ahead for Goblin’s Die.

[b]See you there! [/b]

[i][b]~Potion 8 Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.4.1 is live
notes.content:
Hey-hey-hey!

Goblin's Die Demo has just gotten it's first patch. We did a lot of fiddling around based on your feedback and suggestions. Here's an abstracted list of what's new:

New stuff:
- Inventory / Stash sorting
- Crafting uses materials from your Stash when in Hive
- Equipping gear through ability slots
- Economy rework and gear phasing
- General balancing with numbers all-around

Bug fixes:
- Leather cap shows up in the wrong crafting category 
- Casting banners with the keyboard instead of mouse bypasses cooldown and enables infinite casting for the banner
- Casting slot highlight sometimes stays on if casting is interrupted by dodging
- Some gathering nodes in the spider cave might crash the game
- A boss respawns after a while. Not anymore.

And of course all sorts of level / minor bug fixes.

notes.title: DEMO LIVE NOW ^O_o^
notes.content:
Welcome, meatbags! The Goblin’s Die Demo is now rampaging across Steam — and we’re thrilled to finally shove it into your grubby little hands.

This demo gives you a hearty slice of the upcoming chaos: core gameplay systems, online co-op for up to 4 players, and a plentiful taste of the filthy fun to come. It’s still a work-in-progress (we're goblins, not wizards), so your feedback is pure gold to us. If you want to contribute to the shaping of the game consider joining our goblin Discord and help us mold this monster to it's finest!

Few things about the demo:

- Demo save files will not carry over to the Early Access version

- The game still needs plenty of audio-visual polish—UI magic, visual sparkles, weird noises, and general goblin grime

- Controller support is bubbling in the cauldron for Early Access

- We're conjuring proper graphics settings as we speak

- Performance optimization is underway

- Gameplay balance is still being brewed with questionable ingredients

- Achievements are planned for Early Access

- Expect bugs—both in the gameplay and skulking in the world

Thanks for trying it out — and may your limbs remain attached!

The Potion 8 Crew

notes.title: Towards the DEMO!
notes.content:
We have reached the point where we take down the Alpha Playtest and start fully focusing on the upcoming demo version.

The demo will contain 1-2h of quirky and feature-ready goblin gameplay in a form of the first Act of the game.

Demo will contain sweet new features such as
[list]
[*] Mutation Station
[*] Quartermaster's Shack and
[*] generally improved Hive upgrading.
[/list]
As well as a huge visual update on character models, VFX, level design and lighting.

Not to mention a bunch of new gear, materials, recipes and abilities.

Enemy behavior and boss encounters fully reworked, of course.

. . .

Even if the playtesting phase is over, we still highly suggest you to join our Discord server!

We want to hear your feedback, opinions and ideas. Come chat and chill with the community and contribute to the shaping of the game. Or just keep updated on the progress of the game. Plenty of game art & concept posts.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/SHdEunZSJD]CHARGE TO GOBLIN DISCORD![/url]

We also have a Reddit page, if that is more your cup of berry grog.

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/GoblinsDie/]STORM TO THE SUB-REDDIT![/url]

See you at the demo launch!

Goblin out. ^o_o^

notes.title: Patch notes for 0.3.1.1
notes.content:
This patch includes some fixes and also some UI improvements

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Crafting recipes now unlock properly with hive level-ups.
[*] Clients no longer spawn two loot sacks when dying.
[*] When replacing a two-handed weapon with an off-hand weapon, stats now get updated correctly.
[/list]

[b]UI improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] New and improved tooltip. Includes color coding for ease of reading and it now opens in the location of the mouse.
[*] Rearranged UI windows and fixed some ordering issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for Playtest version 0.3.1
notes.content:
General improvements:

[list]
[*] Targeting enemy is now bound to Q instead of TAB to avoid Steam overlay opening unintentionally
[*] Removed "not close enough" message when targeting a far away enemy
[*] UI graphic updates including new cursor icons
[*] Added loot all functionality with the interact key, E by default
[/list]

Completely reworked the inventory to get rid of many inventory and gathering related bugs including, but not limited to:

[list]
[*] "infinite gathering" issue where gathering only gives the message "inventory is full" and gathering node can be gathered indefinitely.
[*] Dropping a stackable item on itself in the stash would delete the item completely.
[*} Looting a stack of items when there was only room in the inventory for some of the items, would destroy the overflowing items.
[/list]

Bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Hiding inventory with the Z key no longer breaks hovering and highlighting of objects  such as gathering nodes
[*] Thornroot enemies now change target according to threat levels
[*] Removed leftover binding that would hide the inventory
[*] Quest reward icons now get removed from the quest board properly after completing a quest
[*] Roots bloody roots- quest now correctly requires 6 Thornroots to be killed instead of one
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for playtest version 0.2.2
notes.content:
New feature: Shared Stash

[list]
[*]Players can now find a shared stash in the hive where everyone can deposit and withdraw items.
[/list]


General Improvements:

[list]
[*] Removed range checking from targeting.
[*] Many skill animations are now faster to make the combat feel better and more responsive.
[*] Testing some new recipes and a more conservative amount of skills per equipment.
[*] Increased stack sizes of all items to 10-20, except equipment.
[/list]


Bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Enemies no longer start running after random players.
[*] Enemies now reset correctly if they can no longer follow the player.
[*] Enemies who wander off the navigable area now respawn at their original location.
[*] Skills cast on high-latency clients no longer spawn duplicate visual effects
[*] Fixes many minor issues around the map, for example, places where the player could get stuck and out-of-place colliders.
[*] Vfx on projectiles now rotates correctly with the projectile.
[*] Fixed orientation issues where the player would turn to face the wrong direction after dodge rolling or killing an enemy.
[*] Fixed an issue with clients getting "inventory is full"- message when gathering resources from a resource node
[*] Fixed an issue where the player looked blurry when in idle animation.
[*] Party frames now update correctly even in longer sessions.
[*] Levers that open doors now work correctly.
[*] Falling bridge stones now correctly kill the player, when the player gets squashed under one.
[/list]

notes.title: It's time for Alpha Playtest 2!
notes.content:
We have been working hard here at Potion 8 since february to get our next playtest build ready for public testing. 

Approximately 3 months have passed and as the project matures and we get further into production we raise the bar for ourselves as well about what we want to show to you.

In this playtest our main focus has been improving the combat of the game, which includes the following: 

[list]
[*] More types of enemies
[*] Skills for both players and enemies
[*] Better AI for the enemies
[/list]

We are already aware of some of the drawbacks with our current systems but believe strongly enough that we are going in the right direction with how combat works in the game. We are also confident enough about the current state of the combat that we want to share it with all of you to test and give feedback to see if you share our vision of where we want to take it from here. 

On top of focusing on combat we have also been going through all the feedback we got from our first playtest (Thank you a lot of to everyone who has contributed, it means the world to us) and adjusted the other systems in the game into a direction that we believe is in the direction our early testers want while still maintaining our design pillars that might not have been so clearly communicated in the way some of these features were shown in the first playtest. 

On top of all this we have also been adding a lot of quality of life features, improving the performance of the game and bringing the world more to life with new art, items, weapons and armors. 

We have also completely overhauled the level we had in the original playtest, all the animations for all characters to better communicate the feel and mannerism that we are aiming for with the game world and its habitats. 

In this build we have balanced the game for single player experience and there’s no modification to any numbers based on player count as of yet. We have also added a looking for group channel on our discord where you can ask people to join your games to try out the game in multiplayer. We will try our best to join your games and come play with you, but as we are a small team we need to mainly focus on developing the game further. The game uses an easy way to play together, where you just share the name of the game that you hosted to your friends and they can join the game by using the join game feature with the same name. 

The game is designed for up to 4 players in a game, but we have currently enabled up to 15 people to join one game, which is by no means intended, mainly to benchmark the capabilities of how many players we can have in a game simultaneously, so keep this in mind and also please tell us if you run into any weirdness while playing with higher player counts. 

In this post we will not go into too much detail about how we implemented these changes and what were the steps we took to get here, but we will include more detailed patch notes about what was changed since the last build to our best ability. 

The new build is live now for all players who have already signed up for the playtest and whoever hasn’t can use the button on our steam page to sign up and the game should be added to their library automatically. 

Some people have been having issues with adding the playtest into their library and we are looking for solutions on how to get everyone who wants on board to the playtest. If you have any issues joining the playtest you can contact us most easily through our discord.

Our whole team wishes everyone a great start of the summer and are looking forward to hear what you have to say about our game!
